# Ticket Space

Ticket Space is an Android AR todo app for physical spaces, backed by a
self-hosted PocketBase server. Pre-MVP.

## Start Here

- `README.md`: overview and status.
- `docs/architecture.md`: the design contract (scope, backend schema, Android
  architecture, AR model, engineering rules).
- `AGENTS.md`: agent operating instructions.
- `DECISIONS.md`: project decisions.
- `MANIFEST.md`: file inventory.

## Key Conventions

- Android app: Kotlin + Jetpack Compose (Gradle root in `apps/android/`). Use
  `JAVA_HOME=/opt/android-studio/jbr` and `ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Android/Sdk`;
  adb lives at `$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools/adb`.
- Backend: PocketBase with versioned JS migrations in
  `apps/pocketbase/pb_migrations/`.
- Root tooling: Bun runs Biome over the PocketBase migrations and root config.
- Dependency cooldowns: `bunfig.toml` (Bun) and Renovate `minimumReleaseAge`
  (Gradle version catalog).
- Secrets live in environment variables or gitignored files; never commit them.
- Until CI exists, the local merge gate is `docs/architecture.md` "Engineering
  rules".

## Validation

```bash
./scripts/check-all.sh
```
